answer: A guardian quorum blocks bulk fake identities. A new identity needs three independent guardians, each locking 50 credits in the open mesa registry. Each guardian must mirror-check one sample of the applicant's claimed work before signing. If the identity is later proven fake, all three stakes burn. A rented guardian ring fails because one exposed fake forfeits three stakes at once. The kth fake still needs three fresh stakes, so 1,000 fakes lock 150,000 credits, while an honest applicant pays once, stays clean for three epochs, and enters the haven tier with full rewards.
